best_hook.why: A sobbing mother touches her scarred son's face and says 'I buried you' - instant presumed-dead reveal.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now' - conspiracy reveal lands, who they are and what he'll do hang open.

must_promos.why: 'Someone wanted you to believe I was dead' - ambush was no accident, his men ordered to die - ends on the rulers-of-Ashwood reveal and the mother's horrified gasp.
Presumed-dead son reunion: 'I buried you', 'your whole regiment was destroyed', 'how did you survive?' - 'I wasn't supposed to.'

standalone_risk: 'Ashwood' and who rules it are unnamed, the link to Juliana's trial is absent, and Alexander's identity (the hidden duke) isn't explained.
notes: No violence; reunion plus spoken exposition about a past ambush. The escape/blizzard opening is atmosphere, not a hook.
